page_title: Copysmith — AI Platforms for the New Era of Search & Content

sources.entry: CopySmith - An AI tool focused on generating high-quality marketing copy, ad campaigns, and product descriptions.

summary.name: Copysmith
summary.one_liner: Copysmith is a company that builds three AI content platforms, Frase, Describely, and Rytr, aimed at search ranking, AI-search visibility, product content, and brand writing.
use_cases: Track and improve visibility in AI search results
Generate product descriptions in bulk for eCommerce
Optimize content to rank on Google
Write copy that matches a personal or brand voice
Audit a website for content and search issues
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Copysmith as the maker of three AI platforms: Frase for tracking and optimizing content for AI search (with GEO scoring, AI search tracking, content optimization and a site auditor), Describely for generating product content at scale (bulk generation, data enrichment, brand rules), and Rytr for AI writing that learns a user's voice (MyVoice, multi-channel output, a Chrome extension). It describes these together as a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) content stack. The page gives no pricing details and mostly promotes the products with testimonials and claimed customer counts.
notable: Three specialized platforms (Frase, Describely, Rytr) under one company
Built around Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) with a GEO score feature
Describely targets bulk eCommerce product descriptions
Rytr includes a MyVoice feature and Chrome extension
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Customer count and rating claims (30,000+ content teams, 4.8) are marketing claims not verified here
